build_register_pascal_part: build a call to register_all_pascal_part to register COCO-style Pascal Part datasets with detectron2
create_get_partimagenet_metadata: create a call to _get_partimagenet_metadata to retrieve Pascal Part category metadata for detectron2
test_get_partimagenet_metadata_dog: test _get_partimagenet_metadata with only_dog=True to get dog-only part categories
summarize_pascal_part_categories: summarize the PASCAL_PART_CATEGORIES constant listing 93 object part categories across 12 classes
review_register_all_pascal_part: review register_all_pascal_part to understand how it registers train, val, and dog-train splits
